title: Typo in your last Git commit? Fix it like this #shorts #git
description:
Typo in your commit message or a forgotten file? git commit --amend fixes your last commit, but only before you push.

Full video: "Fix Your Last Git Commit (Typo or Missing File) | Git & GitHub Ep 5" on the Tech-dev channel.
